description: Get entity metadata + recent filings for one company by CIK. Accepts canonical zero-padded CIK ("0000320193"), bare numeric ("320193"), or "CIK0000320193" prefixed. Returns full company profile (name, tickers, exchanges, EIN, SIC, addresses) plus the most-recent ~1000 filings. License: US Government public domain.

cik.description: CIK in any zero-padding form, or CIK-prefixed
